subsystem.name: RuntimeUtilityShims
subsystem.responsibility: Loose set of generic runtime helpers with no single owning class: callback-address registration shims, global-address passthrough wrappers, empty-stub invokers, global flag setters/clearers, debug-log lifecycle hooks, CRT-style string append helpers, list/container reset and teardown, and small typed-field accessors on unidentified this objects.

summary: Proposes generic_runtime_objects as a set of lightweight utility shims rather than a cohesive subsystem. Three wrapper families are recognizable by callee: CallbackRegistrationShim (seven functions passing routine addresses through BooleanToIntConversion 0x00587B3E), GlobalAddressPassthrough (three functions forwarding a global address to sub_4B3DB0), and EmptyStubWrapper (three functions calling the unresolved EmptyStub_0170). Four DebugLogLifecycleHook functions share the StringSplitLoop(2, source, n) + guarded DebugLogWrite pattern on the game enter/setup/exit/restart paths. GlobalFlagController groups four single-write flag shims. The remaining functions are single-method accessor/helper stubs on unidentified this objects (texture-dimension validity, string fallback accessor, destructor, bucket-list teardown, flag-field helper, UI string control, input-axis clamp, db-list reset). No cross-function class identity is proven; every grouping is a GUESS grounded in shared callees or shared field layout on the same this base.

classes.name: LinkedChildContainer
classes.responsibility: Container whose head is this+0x8 and whose traversal descends through child links; provides a skip-and-count operation over sibling and child links.

classes.name: LinkedNode
classes.responsibility: Traversal node reached from the container via *(this+0x30); carries a next-sibling link at +0x24 and a child link at +0x28.

classes.name: StringFallbackAccessor
classes.responsibility: Accessor returning the string pointer at this+0x08, falling back to the default-directory constant when it is NULL.

classes.name: VTableDestructorObject
classes.responsibility: Object with a destructor that installs vtable off_5ACAB0 at this+0x0, conditionally frees this+0x34 and cleans up a sub-object; owning class unknown.

classes.name: TextureSurfaceObject
classes.responsibility: Object exposing two 16-bit texture-surface dimensions at +0x28 and +0x2A; validity is their combined positivity.

classes.name: CallbackRegistrationShim
classes.responsibility: Family of thin wrappers that read a routine slot, cast its address to int and pass it to BooleanToIntConversion (0x00587B3E), returning the normalized result. Registration targets are not evidenced in the packet.

classes.name: GlobalAddressPassthrough
classes.responsibility: Family of trivial wrappers that pass the address of a global (0x007CE048, 0x007CE24D, 0x007CE2A4) to sub_4B3DB0 and return its result unchanged.

classes.name: EmptyStubWrapper
classes.responsibility: Family of stubs whose bodies only call the unresolved EmptyStub_0170, with or without a global address argument.

classes.name: DebugLogLifecycleHook
classes.responsibility: Lifecycle debug-log hooks on game enter/setup/exit/restart: run StringSplitLoop(2, source-path, size) as an assertion check and on success write an 'entered onscreen'/'entered playerf' message through DebugLogWrite.

classes.name: GlobalFlagController
classes.responsibility: Single-write shims over adjacent global flag bytes/dword: sets 0x007CE25C, 0x007CE25E, 0x007CE25F to 1 and clears dword 0x007CE250 to 0 from Game_Post.

classes.name: SessionRestartGuard
classes.responsibility: Guard shim on the session-restart path: when qualifying-DSQ and HUD-disable flags are clear, the session-mode identifier is unset (-1) and the player-vehicle field equals 1, it invokes SessionMenuModeSwitch; always returns 0.

classes.name: CrtStringAppendHelper
classes.responsibility: CRT-style helpers that format a value into a local buffer via StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck (0x0058815F) or select a text fragment, append the result to the caller buffer with strcat, and return 0. Used by config-key and log serialization callers.

classes.name: HandleAndStringAccessor
classes.responsibility: Standalone stdcall helpers: object-handle read into a caller output (via sub_587ECE, returns constant 4) and string-inequality-vs-default comparison writing a bool output.

classes.name: BucketListContainer
classes.responsibility: Object holding four bucket/list head pointers at this+0x0/+0x4/+0x8/+0xC; provides zero-init and teardown that walks each non-null head freeing nodes (next link at node+0x44) via FreeWrapper_7bcf. Used from sub_4A4900.

classes.name: SoundFlagFieldHelper
classes.responsibility: Helper pair writing fields this+0x78 and this+0x84 (reset, or set-to-1 and reset) then conditionally calling FlagFieldBitManipulation (0x0054C030) when this+0x64 is non-zero.

classes.name: UiStringControl
classes.responsibility: Unidentified UI control object: parses an input string to an int, stores and clamps it against bounds at +0x1C/+0x20, and has adjacent narrow fields +0x14/+0x15/+0x16 copied between one another.

fields.name: value_field
fields.type_guess: int (accessed at dword/byte/short width across methods)

classes.name: DbListReset
classes.responsibility: Resets a small db-list/container: zeroes dword_7D2E50 and points three adjacent globals (0x83EE54/0x83EE58/0x83EE5C) at unk_7D2E54, returning the address of dword_7D2E50.

classes.name: InputAxisClamp
classes.responsibility: Clamps an input value read from this+0x2988 to [-1,1] behind a StateCheckWrapper(dword_7CD25C) state check; on state-check failure the raw value is returned unclamped.

interfaces.name: CallbackAddressEncoding
interfaces.purpose: Common pattern where a routine address is cast to int and passed to BooleanToIntConversion (0x00587B3E), whose normalized result is returned. Registration target lives outside these wrappers.

interfaces.name: StructuredTextAppend
interfaces.purpose: Shared convention of appending formatted or selected text onto a caller-owned destination buffer: format via StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck (0x0058815F) then strcat, or strcat a selected global fragment; unconditional 0 return.

compatibility_contracts.name: OnScreenLogLifecycleSemantics
compatibility_contracts.description: Game enter/setup/exit and player-file-restart paths each run StringSplitLoop(2, source-path, size) as an assertion-style check and, when its low byte is non-zero, write an 'entered onscreen'/'entered playerf' message through DebugLogWrite to buffer 0x008AD25C. A replacement must retain a debug-log sink for these lifecycle messages and must preserve the assertion-gate semantics (no log when the check returns zero).

compatibility_contracts.name: GlobalFlagLatchPattern
compatibility_contracts.description: Three adjacent global bytes 0x007CE25C, 0x007CE25E, 0x007CE25F are latched to 1 by dedicated setter shims (from RaceModeSetup, SessionScoringUpdate, and an unknown site) and dword 0x007CE250 is cleared to 0 from Game_Post. The flags' semantic meaning is not established; a replacement must preserve the write pattern (or the functions that encode it), not assume the flags are meaningless.

compatibility_contracts.name: CallbackAddressConversionHelper
compatibility_contracts.description: Routine addresses at 0x0049AFC0, 0x0049B070, 0x004A0020, 0x004A11F0, 0x004A40D0, 0x004A7000 and 0x004B21A0 are read and passed as integer arguments to BooleanToIntConversion (0x00587B3E). A replacement must preserve whatever registration/encoding contract this helper mediates; the callback targets themselves are not evidenced.

compatibility_contracts.name: SerializedValueFormatting
compatibility_contracts.description: Config and log serialization appends floats with '%.5f' (literal at 0x005CD130), integers with '%d' (literal at 0x005C3280), and selected text fragments (0x005CD138 / 0x005CD12C) onto caller-owned buffers via strcat after StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck (0x0058815F). A replacement must preserve the %.5f precision, the %d rendering, and the caller-buffer capacity contract.

compatibility_contracts.name: LinkedNodeLinkLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: Container traversal reads the list head at this+0x8 and follows a next-sibling link at node+0x24 and a child link at node+0x28 on nodes reached from *(this+0x30). A replacement preserving this container must keep the node link offsets and the skip-count semantics (skip a2 siblings, then count descendants).

unresolved: sub_4B3DB0 (callee of 0x0049AFA0, 0x0049FFC0, 0x004A11D0) is absent from the packet callee table; its signature and purpose are unknown, so GlobalAddressPassthrough is grouped only by shared call pattern.
EmptyStub_0170 has no callee evidence entry; the EmptyStubWrapper class groups functions whose only observable body is that unresolved call.
BooleanToIntConversion (0x00587B3E) is evidenced only as receiving routine addresses cast to int; whether it registers, encodes, or merely converts is not established.
byte_5EA438 (0x005EA438) is treated as a default-directory path at DERIVED trust only; its exact role is not evidenced in the packet.

Function 0x004A46E4 carries the decompiler warning 'positive sp value has been detected, the output may be wrong'; the memset length (4 * a1 using the this pointer value) is likely a misdecode and the whole prototype is suspect.
Function 0x004A4000 returns an uninitialized local on the guard-false path; its return value there is undefined.
The semantics of the flag globals 0x007CE25C, 0x007CE25E, 0x007CE25F and dword 0x007CE250 are unknown; only the write pattern is evidenced.
The player-vehicle field at offset 16484 (0x40C4) checked by 0x004A0CB0 has no evidenced meaning.
off_5ACAB0 is treated as a vtable pointer; its contents and the class owning 0x0049A990 are unknown.

resetDbListHead (0x004B2180): the ABI lead labels it a thunk to FUN_004b3ad0, but the body is assignments, and globals 0x83EE54/0x83EE58/0x83EE5C plus unk_7D2E54 appear only in raw source text without structured evidence.

UiStringControl offset 0x14 on base 'this' is accessed at three different widths (dword by 0x004B1BB0, byte by 0x004B1C70, short by 0x004B1FB0); the true field type is UNKNOWN and the grouping is a GUESS.
Offsets 0x00 on base 'this' are written by both VTableDestructorObject (vtable) and BucketListContainer (head zero-init); common ownership of the two objects is not proven.
StringSplitLoop numeric literals (2604, 2610, 2705, 2510) and the low-byte gate on its result are opaque without the callee's source.
seasonScoringDbCallback (0x004B21A0) is an empty stub; its identity and the read of dword_7D2E50 flagged by the IDB (absent from the body) are unverified.
ReverseDynamicsStub (0x004A1EA0) discards its callee result and returns constant 1; the meaning of a1 and of the constant is unexplained.
